QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Witch Malady's Secret Mission
QuestInfo.0: Witch Malady has appeared in Event Hall. This is the busiest time for Witches, so why has she appeared here? Let's ask Witch Malady for an explanation.
QuestInfo.1: Witch Malady has appeared in Event Hall. This is the busiest time for Witches, so why has she appeared here? Let's ask Witch Malady for an explanation.
QuestInfo.2: Witch Malady has appeared in Event Hall. This is the busiest time for Witches, so why has she appeared here? Let's ask Witch Malady for an explanation.

0.0: My goodness! My goodness! Always so busy. If you help me, out of the graciousness of your big heart, I may be able to give you something that you'll find useful--in the name of the Witch Malady!

yes.0: Kekeke! I knew from the moment you spoke that you would be lending me a hand.
yes.1: Talk to me if you want to know more about the things you can do for me.

no.0: How dare you refuse a witch? You're either foolish or really brave. Ha! I'll let you go this time...
